استطببت (form X)
# اِسْتَطْبَبْتُ (istaṭbabtu) /is.tatˤ.bab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَطَبَّ (istaṭabba)
# اِسْتَطْبَبْتَ (istaṭbabta) /is.tatˤ.bab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَطَبَّ (istaṭabba)
# اِسْتَطْبَبْتِ (istaṭbabti) /is.tatˤ.bab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَطَبَّ (istaṭabba)
